All full-time employees are entitled to 20 working days of annual leave per calendar year. Part-time
employees receive annual leave on a pro-rata basis calculated against a 40-hour full-time week.
New employees are eligible for annual leave after completing 3 months of continuous
employment.
Annual leave accrues at a rate of 1.67 days per month of service.
Unused annual leave of up to 10 days may be carried over to the next calendar year. Any
balance exceeding 10 days will lapse on December 31st.

For absences of 1-2 days, employees must notify their manager by 9:00 AM on the first day of
absence.
For absences exceeding 2 consecutive days, a medical certificate from a registered medical
practitioner must be submitted.

approval.

employment contract.
Notice periods begin on the date the written resignation is submitted and accepted by HR.
